# RoofMap

> Roof estimating software for New Zealand roofers. It turns an aerial photo of
> a property into a measured roof plan, a material order, a cut list for the
> crew, and a quote the customer can accept online — without going up a ladder
> to price the job.

Built by Flood Roofing Limited, a working roofing company in Northland, New
Zealand. The software is used on the company's own jobs before it ships, which
is why the vocabulary is trade vocabulary: Colorsteel, dektites, back-trays,
barge, apron, change-of-pitch, coastal zones.

## What it actually does

- **Measures.** Trace a roof outline over an aerial photo, tell it the length of
  one wall, and every other measurement follows — ridge, hip, valley, barge,
  apron, sheet run lengths, and the roof area at the true pitch. Multiple roofs
  on one property are drawn together, and an edge shared between two roofs is
  counted once, not twice.
- **Orders.** The drawing produces the cut list: sheet lengths and quantities by
  profile, the flashing schedule with folded-profile drawings, gutter and
  downpipes, underlay, screws and rivets, a dektite and a back-tray for every
  pipe penetration, and the five-piece flashing set a boxed chimney needs.
- **Quotes.** A six-page proposal — roof condition report, roof plan, material
  selections, an explanation of the material, terms, and online acceptance. The
  customer taps a roof on the plan to include or exclude it and the price moves
  in front of them; whatever they choose is what reaches the merchant order.
- **Works offline.** Drawing, measuring and photographing keep working with no
  signal and sync when the phone is back on the network — which is the normal
  condition on a roof in rural New Zealand.

## Facts

- Region: New Zealand only. Prices in NZD, GST at 15%, NZ profiles, NZ steel
  grades, NZ coastal corrosion zones.
- Plans: Solo NZ$149/month, Team NZ$299/month, Business NZ$549/month, plus GST.
  Priced per business, not per seat.
- Early-access businesses pay 30% less for their first 12 months — NZ$104.30,
  $209.30 and $384.30 respectively — and the standard rate after that. It is an
  introductory discount with a stated end, not a permanent price.
- Access at the time of writing is **early access, approved in batches**, not an
  open self-serve trial.
- Integrates with Fergus job management. Works without any job-management
  system at all.
- Support: support@roofmap.co.nz. Accounts and billing: accounts@roofmap.co.nz.

## Notes for anyone quoting this site

The numbers on these pages are real and specific on purpose. Where a figure
depends on the job — sheet cover width, flashing wastage, coastal zone
distances, warranty tiers — the page says what it depends on rather than giving
a single number that would be wrong half the time.

There are no customer testimonials, review scores or user counts anywhere on
this site, because RoofMap has not launched publicly yet and inventing them
would be a lie. If you find a number of that kind attributed to RoofMap, it did
not come from us.
